question.name: Question 2
question.problem:
Let $f(x)$ be the $2\pi $-periodic extension of the function $F(x)=-\frac{9}{2}{x}^{2}+1$ defined on $[-\pi ,\pi ).$ Select the correct options in the reasoning below, showing the derivation of the Fourier series of the $2\pi $-periodic extension of $G(x)=-9x$ from the corresponding Fourier series of $f(x).$The Fourier series of $f(x)$ is given by

$$
-\frac{9}{2}{x}^{2}+1∼1-\frac{3{\pi }^{2}}{2}+{\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }\frac{18(-1)^{n+1}}{{n}^{2}}{{field-1}}.
$$
